<DESCRIPTION>
Equivalent compact implementation of the existing grim-trigger policy: cooperate until the opponent has defected at least once, then defect permanently.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python

def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 1 if len(opponent_history) > 0 and opponent_history.count(1) > 0 else 0
```
